raceHandling: All TBC class-valid playable races are accepted. The source preset race is used conditionally only when combatant/racial evidence does not identify a valid race.
encounterHandling: Encounter metadata controls duration, model shape, mob type, and optional armor. Unknown encounters use a clearly labeled controlled target and do not claim replay fidelity.
rules: A named specialization is never silently replaced with another model.
APL and talent-profile assumptions are surfaced as conditional coverage when WCL lacks detailed talent ranks.
Healer HPS and tank mitigation or threat are not fabricated by the DPS simulator.
